001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory;
002
003import net.tnemc.item.providers.SkullProfile;
004import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007import java.util.UUID;
008import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
009
010public interface SkullProvider {
011
012  CompletableFuture<ItemStack> provide(UUID owner);
013
014  CompletableFuture<ItemStack> provide(String owner);
015
016  /**
017   * Asynchronously provides a SkullProfile associated with the given UUID.
018   *
019   * @param uuid The unique identifier of the player whose SkullProfile is to be retrieved.
020   * @return A CompletableFuture that, when completed, provides the SkullProfile for the given UUID.
021   *
022   * @since 6.3.0.0
023   */
024  CompletableFuture<SkullProfile> provideProfile(UUID uuid);
025
026  /**
027   * Asynchronously provides a SkullProfile associated with the given player name.
028   *
029   * @param name The name of the player whose SkullProfile is to be retrieved.
030   * @return A CompletableFuture that, when completed, provides the SkullProfile for the given player name.
031   *
032   * @since 6.3.0.0
033   */
034  CompletableFuture<SkullProfile> provideProfile(String name);
035
036  /**
037   * Asynchronously provides a SkullProfile associated with the given UUID and the player's last known name.
038   *
039   * @param uniqueId The unique identifier of the player whose SkullProfile is to be retrieved.
040   * @param lastKnownName The last known name of the player associated with the UUID.
041   * @return A CompletableFuture that, when completed, provides the SkullProfile for the given UUID and name.
042   *
043   * @since 6.3.0.0
044   */
045  CompletableFuture<SkullProfile> provideProfile(UUID uniqueId, String lastKnownName);
046
047  /**
048   * Retrieves a cached SkullProfile associated with the given UUID.
049   * This method does not perform any asynchronous operations and returns
050   * the profile if it is already cached.
051   *
052   * @param uuid The unique identifier of the player whose SkullProfile is to be retrieved.
053   *             Must not be null.
054   * @return The cached SkullProfile associated with the given UUID, or null if no cached profile exists.
055   *
056   * @since 6.3.0.0
057   */
058  SkullProfile getCachedProfile(@NotNull final UUID uuid);
059}
